description: This file contains the controller class for managing tax classes within the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin interface. It provides methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting tax classes, handling HTTP requests, loading models and views, and managing user permissions.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax classes in the admin panel, including functions for listing, editing, adding, and removing tax class entities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of tax classes with header, footer, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of tax classes, primarily called via HTTP response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the list of tax classes, including pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a tax class with pre-filled data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the submission of the tax class form, validating data, and creating or updating records.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected tax classes after permission check and ensures they are not associated with products.
